definitions.ask: Should the waves follow the album's sections, even if a few waves hold only 3 tasks?
definitions.why: each wave review rereads whole sections, and no wave goes over the 5-task Ready cap

choices.label: 7 waves of 3-5 tasks in album section order; no section is split across waves
6 waves of 4-5 tasks in walk order; five sections each split across two waves

definitions.ask: Should each wave task be a short review of that wave's drafts, rather than a bare milestone?
definitions.why: it follows the earlier Wave 1 review and gives new records from the section-fill task a place to go

choices.label: Each wave task is a short reread of the wave that also routes new records into the next wave
Each wave task is a bare "Finish Wave N" marker, closed as soon as it unblocks

definitions.ask: Should the agent complete ^create-draft-tasks after the tasks exist?
definitions.why: Bryan closes his own WIP tasks, and the close logs the Pomodoro work there

choices.label: Leave ^create-draft-tasks In Progress so Bryan closes it from Obsidian
Complete it with a `!sase_blog_drafts:create-draft-tasks` capture after the wave tasks are verified
